description_en: Retrieves the details of a single rule in Web Application Firewall (WAF). You can use this operation to query the configuration and status of a specific rule
description_zh: 获取Web应用防火墙（WAF）中单个规则的详细信息。通过此接口，用户可以查询特定规则的配置和状态
name: GetWafRule

parameters.help_en: The ID of the WAF rule. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2878257.html operation to obtain the ID
parameters.help_zh: WAF规则的ID，可通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2878257.html接口获取
parameters.name: id

parameters.help_en: The site ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2850189.html operation to obtain the ID
parameters.name: site_id
